question: Which paired architectural members are set lower and aligned on the same line?
premises: Two elements are described as lower.
A low wall is aligned on the same line.
inference: The verse specifies paired lower members, intermediate benches, and a low wall arranged in alignment.
uncertainties: Exact architectural referents of antaramañcau and nīvraṃ vary by tradition.
plain_english: Two lower elements and two intermediate benches, along with a low wall, are set aligned on the same line.
